name: Trygve Hammer
page_title: Trygve Hammer's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic-NPL for U.S. House (ND) - At-Large

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Protect women’s freedom to make their own healthcare decisions. As long as we do not have full say on our personal medical decision, we do not have full liberty. The government should not intrude into our personal decisions as patients."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "House Republicans are working to raise the age of retirement for our seniors who have worked their whole lives, rather than raise taxes on their ultra wealthy donors. As a Marine, I have always put my country first. In Congress, I will put the seniors of North Dakota first and protect their benefits."

"North Dakota seniors have worked hard their whole lives, and have earned the freedom to retire without fear of the GOP cutting their social security benefits. When in Congress, I will always vote in favor of our seniors and protect the benefits they rely on and have worked for."

evidence.text: "Profitable corporations and the ultra wealthy need to be paying their fair share. The hard work of regular North Dakotans creates the capital, they should not be alone in carrying the tax burden."
